crossRefs.note: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have…
“Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says Yahweh.
‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in…
I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
“Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says Yahweh, “and I will contend with your children’s children.
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

translations.web: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
translations.bsb: you say, ‘I am innocent. Surely His anger will turn from me.’ Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
translations.kjv: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
translations.asv: Yet thou saidst, I am innocent; surely his anger is turned away from me. Behold, I will enter into judgment with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
